vocab.en: Shall we say ty (to each other)?
vocab.notes: The offer to switch. Usually made by the older or more senior person.
Look the other person in the eye when you clink glasses.
Pletu si to: I mix it up.

dialogue.setting: Friday drinks after work. Paní Kovářová has had a good week.

lines.speaker: Paní Kovářová
lines.cs: [[Tome|Tom|voc|addressing]], víte co? Můžeme si tykat. Já jsem Petra.
lines.en: Tom, you know what? Let's say ty. I'm Petra.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.cs: Na zdraví! A jak se ti tu zatím líbí?
lines.en: Cheers! So how do you like it here so far?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.cs: Moc. Jen si ještě pletu, komu tykat a komu vykat.
lines.en: A lot. I just still mix up who to say ty to and who to say vy to.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.cs: To je normální. Když nevíš, vykej. Nikdo se neurazí.
lines.en: That's normal. When you don't know, say vy. Nobody will be offended.

context.speaker: Petra
context.cs: Můžeme si tykat? Já jsem Petra.
context.en: Shall we say ty? I'm Petra.

exercises.prompt: Accept, as a man, and say your name is Tom.
exercises.why: Accept with jasně, rád (a man) or ráda (a woman), then give your first name.

hints.explain: Ráda is the feminine form. A man says rád.

context.speaker: Pavel
context.cs: Můžeme si tykat? Já jsem Pavel.
context.en: Shall we say ty? I'm Pavel.

exercises.prompt: Accept, as a woman, and say your name is Kate.
exercises.why: A woman accepts with jasně, ráda.

hints.explain: Rád is the masculine form. A woman says ráda.

exercises.prompt: Who usually offers to switch to ty: the **older** person or the **younger** one?
exercises.why: The older or more senior person offers ty. Between a man and a woman of about the same age, traditionally the woman offers.

exercises.prompt: Jak se ___? (to Petra, now that you say ty)
exercises.why: After switching to ty, use 2nd person singular: Jak se máš?

hints.explain: Máte is vy. You now say ty to Petra: Jak se máš?

answers: {When|If} {you don't know|you're not sure|you are not sure|in doubt}[,] {say|use} vy
exercises.why: Když nevíš, vykej: when you don't know, say vy (vykej is the ty imperative of vykat).
Petra in the vocative: -a becomes -o, Petra → Petro.
